mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather. We are looking at overcast skies with a temperature of 66 degrees out at Reddan Soccer Park. If you are a space enthusiast, look up tonight at 8:23 PM for a six-minute pass of the International Space Station as it travels from the Cross Plains area toward Madison.

In local news, the Verona Police Department responded to a residential burglary on September 10th at Hunter's Cove Way. A suspect was apprehended, and no injuries were reported despite a weapon being discharged during the incident.

There is plenty to do in our community. Yoga is available today at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead, tomorrow features trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, and later this week you can catch live music at Paddy Mac's, Bailey's Run, and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

On Thursday, September 10, officers were dispatched to a residence on Hunter's Cove Way for a burglary in progress. The suspect was located, taken into custody, and will be charged with burglary and reckless endangerment.

For those looking for a treat, please note that the Culver's in Verona is currently closed for a building remodel. We will keep you updated on when you can return to grab your favorite flavor of the day.
